trigger: In the preceding raw run, the retained model scored 1228/1693 on the primary fold, a quarter-share adviser 1227, half-share 1225, and adviser alone 1143. Both confirmation histories were empty. The preceding development study on two other allocations and the small/large fidelity study justify testing whether one noisy near-miss should receive evidence rather than immediate elimination. This protocol was filed before reading either new arm's designated validation score and before running any additional confirmation classifier.
admission: If a positive share strictly improves primary accuracy, keep the already frozen strict algorithm. Otherwise take the strongest share in (0,.25,.5,1] only by those primary counts (smallest positive share in a tie). To spend on confirmation it must actually fix at least one incumbent error, its primary net loss must not exceed one paired standard-error unit computed from gained/lost rows, and adequate fit/time capacity must remain. Any number of future tasks may reject all extra options. No model IDs or number of points observed above enter the generic rule.
deployment: For a near miss, lock share and candidate first. Require STRICT gains on each of the two original empty confirmation folds and a pooled gain of at least 0.3 percentage points on ALL three folds, including the primary loss. Otherwise retain the already fitted incumbent. For a positive primary retain the original confirmation rule unchanged. No retuning of weight after confirmation.
resource: First independently replay the frozen prefix only, with no external labels and at most four new confirmation fits (two controls and two neighbour indices). If and only if the registered deployment condition passes, test the changed ordinary raw entry from scratch with the same sixteen-fit limit, 1800 seconds and same complete directory, then perform one sealed external evaluation for that version. If it fails, do not repeat the entire common prefix. Refer to the original frozen 16-fit control.
data: No designated labels for the decision or held-rescue study. Record exact gaps, corrections, split fingerprints, true fits; preserve the ordinary 10-fit release on an independent branch. No API, H2 or official test.
